scope: Exploratory Stage8 extension. Historical benchmark labels/results have already been observed; no fresh confirmatory test claim.
adapter: Separate image/text low-rank residual projections, normalized output; backbone frozen
training_source: Only historically previously_seen SugarCrepe images (555), with original authored positive/negative pairs
split: Deterministic shuffled image IDs, seed20261009; 80% train/20% validation; no image or image-byte-hash overlap with historical unseen SugarCrepe or expert images
selection: For each run choose highest image-macro validation pair accuracy, earliest epoch on ties. Select rank/anchor by mean validation score across five seeds, ties prefer smaller rank then stronger anchor. Never select using benchmark/human scores.
main_output: Five selected-config models and mean-score ensemble; report all seeds, never best test seed
ranking_gain: NDCG gain=2^(mean_rating-1)-1, average DCG across score ties; evaluate groups with >=2 captions and nonzero gain
reference_tokenization: COCO PTBTokenizer; no LLM references; original author ground_truth
reference_cider_idf: Standard pycocoevalcap candidate-record corpus (references repeated per rated candidate), explicitly recorded
optional_reference_baselines: SPICE when explicitly enabled and Java assets available
gpu_additions: PAC-S using official pinned source and trained checkpoint with SHA receipt
fresh matched-session Gemma/SigLIP2-224/CLIP B32 latency and peak memory, batch1 and8, real expert inputs
prohibited_claims: No fresh holdout claim for previously seen benchmarks
independent_test_required_for_new_claim: Choose and lock an external human/compositional evaluation set after train/validation configuration is frozen; audit overlap and evaluate once. Not provided or evaluated in this Stage8 prototype.
